You are helping with an AUTHORIZED, READ-ONLY security audit of a Next.js App Router codebase at /opt/nxeon. These files are `"use server"` action modules — every exported async function is a remotely-invokable HTTP endpoint an attacker can POST to directly with arbitrary arguments. DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING. Only Read/grep.

Auth model (from /opt/nxeon/lib/auth.ts): `requireUser()` returns the current user or throws; `requireAdmin()` throws unless ADMIN. An action is IDOR-vulnerable if it accepts an id (serverId, siteId, websiteId, databaseId, accountId, certId, cronId, ruleId, etc.) as a parameter and acts on it WITHOUT verifying the caller owns it (e.g. `findFirst({where:{id, userId: user.id}})`, or a local helper like `ownedServer()`/`loadOwned()` that checks `.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "ADMIN"`). A helper that loads the object scoped to the user counts as proper.

For EACH of these files:
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-apps.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-databases.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-websites.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-sites.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-ssl.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-cron.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-firewall.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-mods.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-hosting.ts

Enumerate every EXPORTED async function that reaches a dangerous sink: `db.job.create` or `db.hostingTask.create` (enqueues work a worker executes — the hosting worker or root worker), `spawn`/`exec`, `writeFile`/SFTP write, or credential mint/reset. For each report EXACTLY:
- file:line and function name
- the auth guard present (quote the line), or NONE
- whether it verifies the caller OWNS the id argument before the sink (quote the ownership-check line, or "NO OWNERSHIP CHECK")
- the job/task type or sink reached
- VERDICT: OK / IDOR / NO-AUTH / WEAK

Quote real lines with numbers. Flag especially: caller-supplied id flowing into job.create/hostingTask.create with no ownership check; and any hostingTask/job payload carrying attacker-controlled structured data (command, path, url, version, appId, php version, etc.) — list those payload shapes and whether the values are validated/allowlisted. actions-hosting.ts is large (~3000 lines); focus only on exported functions that hit hostingTask.create or exec or file writes. Tight bulleted list per file, most dangerous first. No speculation beyond the code.

I've now read all nine files in full and traced every exported function to its sink and guard. Here is the audit.

## Summary verdict

**No IDOR, NO-AUTH, or WEAK findings in any of the nine files.** Every exported `"use server"` function that reaches a dangerous sink (`db.job.create`, `db.hostingTask.create`, SFTP write/delete, credential mint) either (a) verifies the caller owns the id argument via a scoped helper before the sink, or (b) is admin/staff-gated via `requireArea("fleet")` for functions intended to act on any account. Every task/job payload carries either server-derived ids/secrets or validated/allowlisted values — no attacker-controlled free-form `command`/`path`/`url`/`version`/`slug` reaches a worker unchecked.

The consistent ownership pattern is `if (X.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "ADMIN") throw/return "Forbidden"`, exactly the shape the auth model treats as proper. `actions-sites.ts` is even stricter (no ADMIN bypass).

---

## actions-hosting.ts (2174 lines — all sink-reaching exports)

Customer functions (ownership-checked):
- **`resetHostingDbPassword` (1019)** — guard `const user = await requireUser();` (1020) + `assertNotImpersonating()` (1021); ownership `if (d.account.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "ADMIN") return { error: "Forbidden." };` (1027). Sink: `hostingTask.create` kind `RESET_DB_PASSWORD` (1029), payload `{dbUser (owned row), passEnc (server-generated)}`. **OK**
- **`installDbTool` (1053)** — `requireUser` (1054)+`assertNotImpersonating` (1055); ownership (1058). Sink: `INSTALL_DBTOOL` (1067), payload `{token,path}` both server-constructed (`randomBytes` hex, `isValidDbToolToken`). **OK**
- **`setHostingPhpVersion` (1148)** — guard `ownedActiveAccount` (1149, ownership at 1078); sink `PHP_SWITCH` (1152), payload `{version}` validated `PHP_RE` **and** allowlisted `planLimits(plan).phpVersions.includes(version)` (1151). **OK**
- **`installWordPress` (1195)** — `ownedActiveAccount` (1196); sink `WORDPRESS_INSTALL` (1209). Payload dbName/dbUser derived from `a.username`, passwords `randomBytes`, `adminUser:"admin"` hardcoded, `target` validated by `validateSiteTarget` (scoped `findFirst({id, accountId})`, 1181/1187). **OK**
- **`installApp` (1240)** — `ownedActiveAccount` (1241); sink `APP_INSTALL` (1257). `slug` allowlisted against `hostingAppCatalog()` (1244), `target` validated (1246). **OK**
- **`restoreHostingBackup` (1376)** — `ownedActiveAccount` (1377); `backupId` scoped `findFirst({ id: backupId, accountId })` (1379); sink `RESTORE` (1381). **OK**
- **`createHostingBackup` (1356)** — `ownedActiveAccount`; sink `BACKUP` (1362), no payload. **OK**
- **`upgradeHostingPlan` (1309)** — ownership (1314); sink `APPLY_PLAN_LIMITS` (1344), no free-form payload; `newPlanId` re-loaded+validated. **OK**
- **`hostingMkdir` (1414) / `hostingDeleteFile` (1426) / `hostingListFiles` (1399)** — guard `ownedAccountWithNode` (ownership 1392). SFTP write/delete sink. `relPath` is attacker-controlled but the SFTP session connects **as the jailed account user** (OS chroot is the boundary — `lib/hosting-fs.ts:37-48`), and `safeRel` (hosting-fs.ts:29-35) rejects `..`, `\0`, and non-`[A-Za-z0-9._/\- ]`. Confined to caller's own chroot + traversal-checked. **OK**
- **`createSubdomain` (1533)** — `ownedSiteAccount` (1534); sink `CREATE_SUBDOMAIN` (1558) payload `{subdomainId}` (fresh, created same tx). **OK**
- **`deleteSubdomain` (1569)** — ownership `if (sub.account.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "ADMIN")` (1573); sink `DELETE_SUBDOMAIN` (1575) payload `{subdomainId: id}` (owned). **OK**
- **`createAddonDomain` (1580)** — `ownedSiteAccount`; sink `CREATE_ADDON_DOMAIN` (1604) payload `{addonId}` (fresh). Domain validated + cross-tenant `isHostnameClaimed` + atomic `UNIQUE(hostname)` claim. **OK**
- **`deleteAddonDomain` (1615)** — ownership (1619); sink `DELETE_ADDON_DOMAIN` (1621). **OK**
- **`setPrimaryHostingDomain` (1744)** — ownership (1749) + addon scoped `findFirst({ id: addonId, accountId })` (1751); sink `SET_PRIMARY_DOMAIN` (1759) payload `{addonId, newDomain (=addon.domain, owned), oldDomain}`. **OK**
- **`createCron` (1771)** — `ownedSiteAccount`; sink `CREATE_CRON` (1784) payload `{cronId}` only. The `command` free-text is validated (`isValidCronCommand`, 1778) and stored on the row (worker reads DB); runs in the customer's own jailed cron. **OK**
- **`deleteCron` (1794)** — ownership (1798); sink `DELETE_CRON` (1800). **OK**
- **`createHostingDatabase` (951)** — ownership (956); credential mint (no task), name derived from `a.username`, serializable cap check. **OK**
- **`revealHostingSftpPassword` (870)** / **`revealHostingDbPassword` (998)** — credential reveals, ownership (877 / 1006) + `assertNotImpersonating`. **OK**
- Order/fulfilment: **`orderHostingAccount` (105)** `requireUser`(112)+`assertNotImpersonating`(113), self-order (creates own account, no attacker accountId). **`placeHostingCardOrder` (664)** derives user from `getCheckoutPurpose(sessionId)` — Stripe session re-verified server-side, foreign id returns `{skip}` (668); not an accountId arg. Internal `queueHostingAppInstall` (`WORDPRESS_INSTALL`/`APP_INSTALL`, 734/755) is called only from `placeHostingOrderCore` (642) with the freshly-created `res.accountId`. **OK**

Admin functions — all gated `await requireArea("fleet")` (staff/ADMIN gate, `lib/rbac.ts`; throws for customers), intended to operate on any account:
- **`adminSuspend/Unsuspend/TerminateHostingAccount` (2114/2125/2136)** → `queueLifecycleTask` → `hostingTask.create` SUSPEND/UNSUSPEND/TERMINATE (2111). **OK (admin)**
- **`cancelHostingAccount` (2157)** — self-serve; ownership (2164)+`assertNotImpersonating`; sink TERMINATE (2167). **OK**
- **`adminHardenHostingNode` (2033) / `adminDeployHostingNodeTelemetry` (2053)** — `requireArea("fleet")`; queue SSH-executing worker sweeps against a node (root pw), fleet-gated. **OK (admin)**
- `adminSaveHostingPlan`/`adminCreateHostingNode`/etc. — `requireArea("fleet")`, config only. **OK (admin)**

---

## actions-apps.ts (VPS one-click apps)
- **`installApp` (161)** — `ownedServer(serverId)` (168; ownership at 74 `if (server.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "ADMIN") throw`); sink `db.job.create` `APP_INSTALL` (248), payload `{appId: appRow.id}` (freshly created in tx). `appSlug` allowlisted (`appBySlug`, 175), `domain` `DOMAIN_RE` (184), `adminUser` sanitized (194). **OK**
- **`removeApp` (278)** — `ownedApp(id)` (280; ownership at 82); sinks `WEBSITE_DELETE`/`DB_DELETE` (291/298), payload ids read from the owned app row. **OK**

## actions-databases.ts
- **`createDatabase` (113)** — `ownedServer` (120); sink `DB_CREATE` (156) payload `{databaseId: row.id}` (fresh). `engine` allowlisted (`DB_ENGINES`, 127), name/user `IDENT_RE` (131-134). **OK**
- **`deleteDatabase` (168)** — `ownedDatabase(id)` (170; ownership 54); sink `DB_DELETE` (174) payload `{databaseId: id}` (owned). **OK**

## actions-websites.ts
- **`createWebsite` (208)** — `ownedServer` (215); sink `WEBSITE_CREATE` (253) payload `{websiteId}` (fresh). `domain` `DOMAIN_RE`, `phpVersion` `PHP_VERSION_RE`+`PHP_VERSIONS` allowlist (227). **OK**
- **`toggleWebsite` (264) / `requestWebsiteSsl` (280) / `deleteWebsite` (298)** — `ownedWebsite(id)` (ownership 59); sinks `WEBSITE_TOGGLE`/`WEBSITE_SSL`/`WEBSITE_DELETE`, payload `{websiteId: id}` (owned). **OK**
- **`pointWebsiteDns` (167)** — `ownedWebsite`; Cloudflare DNS write; hostname from owned row, ip from `publicIpOf` (both server-side, re-validated in `pointHostnameToIp`). **OK**

## actions-sites.ts (website builder)
- **`publishSite` (254) / `unpublishSite` (282)** — `ownedSite(id)` (58; ownership `if (site.userId !== user.id) throw`, no ADMIN bypass); sinks `SITE_PUBLISH`/`SITE_UNPUBLISH` payload `{siteId}` (owned). **OK**
- `saveDraft` (197) validates `isSiteDocument` + 5 MB cap; other exports read-only/own-scope. **OK**

## actions-ssl.ts
- **`requestCertificate` (159)** — `ownedServer` (165); sink `SSL_ISSUE` (223) payload `{certId (fresh), domain}`, domain `FQDN_RE` (172). **OK**
- **`renewCertificate` (242)** — `ownedCertificate(id)` (245; ownership 63); sink `SSL_ISSUE` (275) payload from owned row. **OK**
- `deleteCertificate` (301) / `toggleAutoRenew` (347) — `ownedCertificate`, no worker sink. **OK**

## actions-cron.ts
- **`createCronJob` (149) / `updateCronJob` (196)** — `ownedServer`/`ownedCron` (ownership 63/71); sink `CRON_SYNC` payload `{}` (state-driven, worker rebuilds from DB). `schedule` via `assertCronSchedule`, `command` via `validateCommand` (control chars rejected, ≤500). Note: shell metacharacters in `command` are allowed by design (runs in the customer's own crontab via here-doc STDIN, never interpolated — documented 95-101); ownership-gated to the caller's own server. **OK**
- **`serviceAction` (278)** — `ownedServer`; sink `SERVICE_ACTION` (295) payload `{unit,action}` both allowlisted (`COMMON_SERVICES` 288 / `SERVICE_ACTIONS` 290). **OK**
- **`getServiceStatuses` (262) / `getProcessSnapshot` (308)** — `ownedServer`; inline SSH read (`cpanel-inline`). **OK**
- `toggleCronJob`/`deleteCronJob` — `ownedCron`, `CRON_SYNC` `{}`. **OK**

## actions-firewall.ts
- **`addFirewallRule` (41)** — `ownedServer(serverId)` from formData (43); `validateRule` gates every field (47); sink `SYNC_FIREWALL` (30) serverId-only. `comment` sliced, never shell-bound. **OK**
- **`toggleFirewallRule` (99) / `deleteFirewallRule` (112)** — `ownedServer` + rule scoped `{ id: ruleId, serverId }` (101/114), so a foreign ruleId can't match. **OK**
- **`reorderFirewallRules` (128)** — `ownedServer`; filters `orderedIds` to server-owned ids (133-134). **OK**

## actions-mods.ts
- **`installMod` (130) / `uninstallMod` (171)** — `ownedServer(serverId)` (ownership 28); sink `GAME_MOD_SYNC` (161/193) serverId-only (state-driven). `modId` validated as an existing catalog `gameMod` with matching family/variant (138-143). **OK**

---

Key files for reference: ownership helpers live at `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-hosting.ts:1074` (`ownedActiveAccount`), `:1388` (`ownedAccountWithNode`), `:1447` (`ownedSiteAccount`), `:1501` (`assertSiteOwner`); the chroot-jailed SFTP layer at `/opt/nxeon/lib/hosting-fs.ts`; the auth primitives at `/opt/nxeon/lib/auth.ts`; the staff gate `requireArea` at `/opt/nxeon/lib/rbac.ts`.
